AboutPage.title: About me
AboutPage.titleText: I am a frontend developer who loves turning complex designs into fast, responsive and user-friendly interfaces. Details matter to me — performance, accessibility, clean code — they are what make a product pleasant to use.
AboutPage.name: Vyacheslav Goglev
AboutPage.aboutText: Over the past few years I have been developing web applications and landing pages for startups and small teams. From the first markup to deployment and optimisation — I take part in every stage and enjoy working closely with designers. My toolkit includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. I am also confident working with REST APIs, Git and modern build tools.

PortfolioPage.title: Portfolio
PortfolioPage.titleText: A collection of projects I've worked on: from landing pages and dashboards to small web apps. Each project is a real task that had to be solved cleanly, quickly, and conveniently for the user.

shoesShop.title: Shoes Shop
shoesShop.description: An online store with a catalog, cart, and checkout. Frontend built with Next.js and Redux, backend with NestJS.

studyBuddyApp.title: Study Buddy
studyBuddyApp.description: An app for collaborative studying: flashcards, timers, and progress tracking. Auth and database powered by Supabase.

myBonchApp.title: MyBonch
myBonchApp.description: A mobile web app for students: schedule, grades, and notifications all in one place.
